title: Composer
responsibility: Collects a comment or agent request and sends it through the appropriate parent callback only when its mode and prerequisites permit submission.

inputs.name: Composer.modes
inputs.description: Ordered list of the modes this context allows (comment, ask, plan, change): the first is used until the person picks a mode, and falls back to the first whenever the chosen mode is no longer offered. An empty list disables the message box and submission, and the mode buttons appear only when more than one mode is offered.

inputs.name: Composer.providers
inputs.description: Provider states passed to the agent controls that appear for Ask, Plan and Change; comments do not use them. An agent request cannot be submitted until those controls set a non-null agent choice.

examples.label: Codex CLI
examples.reason: Sign in to Codex CLI with a ChatGPT subscription.

examples.reason: Sign in to Claude CLI with a subscription.

examples.reason: Sign in to Codex CLI with a ChatGPT subscription.

inputs.name: Composer.approved
inputs.description: Whether Change is approved for the current design: when false, the Change mode button (when shown) is disabled, a Notice asks for approval, and Change submission is blocked even when Change is the only offered mode. It has no effect on Ask, Plan or Comment.

inputs.name: Composer.running
inputs.description: Whether work is already running: when true, the message box and submission are disabled in every mode. It does not disable the mode buttons or the provider selection.

inputs.name: Composer.notice
inputs.description: Optional hint shown in the non-agent layout; a nonempty value replaces the default comment hint. It is hidden while Ask, Plan or Change is selected.
examples: Only comments are open while this design is in review.

inputs.name: Composer.failureReported
inputs.description: True when the parent already displays the current send failure, which hides this component’s “Couldn’t send” alert that otherwise appears after a false callback result.

inputs.name: Composer.placeholder
inputs.description: Message-box prompt for Plan and Change; an empty value shows “Describe the next design…”. Ask always shows “Ask a question…” and Comment always shows “Leave a comment…”, whatever this value is.

inputs.name: Composer.visual
inputs.description: Whether a Plan is visual: when true, a Plan request includes the device’s design-option count (agentSettings.designOptions) as designOptions, and a caption shows that count. Ask, Change and Comment never include the count, so the flag has no effect on them.

inputs.name: Composer.compact
inputs.description: Turns on the compact composer styling and, passed to the agent controls, makes the agent choices icons that open pickers.

inputs.name: Composer.comment
inputs.description: Required asynchronous callback for Comment mode, called with the trimmed text: a true result clears the text, while a false result keeps it and shows the retry alert unless failureReported is true. A rejected promise is not caught here, so the text is kept and the call sets no failure state.

inputs.name: Composer.send
inputs.description: Required asynchronous callback for Ask, Plan and Change, called only when an agent choice is set, with a RunDraft holding the trimmed text, the mode (ask, plan or change), the provider, model and effort (effort may be null), and designOptions for a visual Plan. A true result clears the text, a false result keeps it, and a rejected promise is not caught here.

outputs.name: Composer
outputs.description: Form with a message box, Request-mode buttons when more than one mode is offered, agent controls for Ask, Plan and Change, a send button, and a retry alert after a false result from either callback unless failureReported is true. Submission is blocked without a mode, with blank text, while running, without an agent choice for a request, or for an unapproved Change, and comments go to the comment callback without starting an agent.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: Rejections from the comment or send callback are not caught, because submit awaits them with no try block. The form starts submit with void, so no handler in this component receives the rejection, and the message text is kept.

errors.name: Device agent settings load on mount
errors.description: An error thrown by agentSettings.load(), which runs on mount, is not caught by this component.

dependencies.contract: The shared Select component supplies keyboard and value selection behavior through the $shared alias.
